lead.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI across all tiers
lead.summary: OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6 with Intelligent UI, a dynamic interface that combines text, graphics, charts, and interactive elements. GPT-6 Sol (paid) and GPT-6 Luna (free) now deliver context-aware UI components to Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise users, marking a shift from purely text-based chat to mixed-media AI interactions.

top_stories.title: Google DeepMind makes SynthID Detector publicly available for cross-platform AI content provenance
top_stories.summary: SynthID Detector is now public, letting anyone check whether content was generated by Google AI, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, or Apple models — a major step for cross-platform AI watermark verification.

top_stories.title: SpaceX wants to borrow $40 billion to buy Nvidia AI chips as infrastructure demand surges
top_stories.summary: SpaceX is raising ~$40B in debt ($10B bank loans, $30B bonds) to purchase Nvidia AI GPUs. Apollo Global Management leads the financing as Morgan Stanley warns AI infrastructure will need $1.5 trillion in outside financing by 2028.

top_stories.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live speech-to-speech models with direct listening and reasoning
top_stories.summary: Gemini 3.8 Live bypasses traditional speech-to-text-to-LLM pipelines for direct listening, reasoning, and speaking. Extended Thinking version leads the Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech Index at $0.84/hour of input audio.

top_stories.title: Nous Research raises $90M Series B at $1.5B valuation for open-source Hermes Agent
top_stories.summary: Nous Research closed a $90M Series B led by Robot Ventures, with NVIDIA, Microsoft M12, Samsung Next, USV, Y Combinator, and Menlo Ventures participating. Hiring and a mobile app are in the works for the enterprise AI assistant.

items.title: CoTrace: data recipes for training terminal agents with harness-model co-evolution
items.summary: Terminal-agent capability depends jointly on model weights and the runtime harness. CoTrace introduces data recipes that treat trajectories produced during harness search as differentiated training signal.

items.title: What matters for latent reasoning with flow matching
items.summary: Identifies training choices for flow matching in latent reasoning space. The FLaRe recipe reaches 97% of explicit CoT accuracy at 25% latency, evaluated across five requirements.

items.title: EngramEdit: decoupled knowledge updates in LLMs through conditional memory
items.summary: Uses the DeepSeek Engram architecture to decouple factual knowledge storage from model parameters, enabling targeted edits without full retraining.

items.title: YANchor-4B: effective long-horizon reasoning in O(N) time with O(1) memory
items.summary: A general-purpose recurrent model that preserves crucial information across long horizons while keeping generation cost manageable. Achieves strong results at 4B scale.

items.title: SemanticFold: latent sequence compression separates language modeling, decodability, and reasoning
items.summary: Compresses prefix hidden states at learned boundaries, evaluated across five model scales from Qwen3-1.7B to 27B.

items.title: Nvidia RTX Spark PC platform launches with pre-orders open
items.summary: Nvidia launched the RTX Spark PC powered by the N1X chip (Grace CPU + Blackwell GPU), featuring 5th-gen Tensor Cores, DLSS 5, and up to 128 GB unified memory. Pre-orders opened with shipping starting October 16.

items.title: Faraday Future plans US robot factory for humanoids
items.summary: Faraday Future plans a US robotics factory by end of 2026, retrofitting its Hanford California plant. First robots are the Next Futurist humanoid and Next Aegis quadruped, targeting February 2027 production.

items.title: Teradyne Robotics and Elite Robots settle cobot software dispute
items.summary: The companies resolved their copyright-infringement lawsuit over cobot software by mutual agreement with no disclosed terms. Teradyne continues a separate patent lawsuit against Chinese cobot maker Jaka Robotics.

items.title: IrisGo for solopreneurs — AI desktop agent that learns your workflows
items.summary: An AI desktop agent that watches your screen, learns your workflows, and automates them. Backed by Andrew Ng's AI Fund, launched on Product Hunt as public beta.

items.title: Video Editor in Manus 2.0 — full AI video editing from natural language
items.summary: Manus 2.0 adds a full AI video editor that composes, edits, and exports professional videos from natural language prompts and existing footage.

items.title: GenPage 3.0 — AI landing pages that auto-test every variant
items.summary: AI-powered landing page platform that learns your brand, builds dedicated pages per ad or keyword, and auto-tests every variant for conversion optimization.

items.title: Databench by Alkera — open-source collaborative workspace for data teams
items.summary: Open-source collaborative agentic workspace combining data engineering, analysis, and science in multiplayer sessions with AI agents.

items.title: Mecka AI nabs $60M from Sequoia for robot training data
items.summary: Series B led by Sequoia, with NVIDIA and Microsoft M12 participating. The startup collects human motion data to train physical AI and robots.

items.title: Healthleap raises $38M for AI that flags hospital patients who need closer attention
items.summary: $8M seed co-led by Sequoia Capital and First Round Capital, $30M Series A led by Hummingbird Ventures. AI detects clinical risk signals in hospital patients.

items.title: Personal AI assistant Tab emerges from stealth at $300M valuation
items.summary: Undisclosed raise at $300M valuation, backed by SV Angel, Valar Ventures, and American Spirit. Consumer AI assistant for personal productivity.
